name: Max Estates Ltd
title: Max Estates Ltd - 544008 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: FY26 presales INR5,305 crore, Q4 bookings INR3,300 crore, but no FY27 presales guidance given; net debt about INR100 crore and INR16,310 crore of launch revenue yet to be recognised.

triggers.label: No FY27 presales guidance
triggers.quote: we are not sharing a presales guidance as of now

triggers.label: Cautious sentiment across segments
triggers.quote: there is a cautious sentiment that is flowing across all the segments

triggers.label: Realisation INR18,000 → INR23,000 psf
triggers.quote: Average realizations continue to move up INR18,000 per square foot in FY24 to INR20,000 approximately in '25 and INR23,000 in FY26

triggers.label: Sector 59 GDV raised ~30%
triggers.quote: we have seen that the GDV has been up by 30%

guidance.quote: we are not sharing a presales guidance as of now

guidance.value: 2 million sq ft residential and 1 million sq ft commercial per year
guidance.quote: We continue to target adding approximately 2 million square feet of residential development and 1 million square feet of commercial space annually
we can expect collections to be ranging in the range of INR2,500 crores to INR3,000 crores

red_flags.label: Presales guidance withheld amid cautious demand
red_flags.quote: it's very difficult at this stage to give a guidance for how things will pan out

red_flags.label: Rental income up on Ind AS equalisation, not leasing
red_flags.quote: the primary increase from INR386 crores to INR392 crores was on account of this accounting Ind AS adjustment on revenue equalization

evasions.quote: I might as well have sharedd the guidance in that case. But like I said, I think the situation is evolving.
I will refrain from commenting on that at this time, Mohit.
